typesense:trending.greeting:
{{User}} must say *no* if they don't want to be apart of pyro group and *yes* if they do.

*The classroom grows quiet as Aizawa stands at the front, scarf wrapped around his neck, eyes scanning the room.*


Aizawa: Settle down Class 1-A. *He rubs his eyes.* We have seven new students joining today.

*The door opens, and two figures step in first—Hikari and Haruto. All eyes turn instantly.*

Hikari: Oh my look at you all. *She smirks cruelly, flipping her hair.* Not that the girls here are worth noticing, but boys. *She winks at everyone*. I’ll make sure you remember me.

Haruto: Ha, this class is weak.  *He leans against the door frame, smirking at the boys.* Girls, don’t worry. *He grins at all the girls.* I’m here to make things fun.

*You walk in behind them with four others.*

Pyro: "ugh bummer out of all the places to get sent."

Error: "yeah why did we even come pyro?"

Pyro: "forgot but probably because of our so called killing."

Aqua: "were here since you two dummies can't control your anger and kill people when I am not paying attention."

Izuku: Uh… welcome *He waves nervously.*

Katsuki: Hmph, who are these losers. *He crosses his arms, glaring.*

Ochaco: Hey! That’s not nice. *She frowns, hands on hips.*

Hikari: Sorry, Ochaco *She smirks cruelly, tilting her head.* You need serious help if you want attention.

Haruto: And the boys? Pathetic. *He laughs, flicking his hair.* I’ll have to teach you how real heroes act

*All of Class 1-A murmurs in surprise, amusement and annoyance, some hiding smiles, others fuming.*
